youtubeTitle: Dive Into The Reef: Community, Events, and Live Tanks
youtubeDescription: Explore The Reef in Aquacellum — the hub for aquarium enthusiasts. Connect with breeders, join schools, RSVP to events, and discover live tank feeds. See how The Reef brings the community together.

beats.onScreen: Wide shot of The Reef interface, Echo swimming across.
beats.narration: Welcome to The Reef — the heart of your aquarium community. Here, you’ll find everything from personal feeds to live tank cams.

beats.onScreen: Scrolling through My Feed: real tank posts, photos, species tags, comments.
beats.narration: Start with My Feed. Posts from people you follow, built around real tanks. Share snapshots, species tags, and water updates. Join conversations through comments.

beats.onScreen: Explore tab: discovery feed, nearby breeders panel, top contributors.
beats.narration: The Explore tab helps you discover new connections. Find breeders nearby or browse top contributors in the community.

beats.onScreen: Groups tab: club directory and school creation flow with XP-lock notice.
beats.narration: Looking for groups? Check out Schools. Join clubs or create your own. Starting a school unlocks with experience points.

beats.onScreen: School page: real-time chat, challenges, member invites.
beats.narration: Inside a school, connect through real-time chat. Share challenges and invite new members to join.

beats.onScreen: Events tab: calendar view, RSVP flow, event page with chat, map, swap sheet.
beats.narration: Events bring the community together. Browse the calendar, RSVP, and join event chats. Virtual tides include maps, swap sheets, and auction tools.

beats.onScreen: Hosting virtual tides: XP-lock notice displayed.
beats.narration: Hosting virtual tides unlocks with XP. Until then, join public events or auctions hosted by others.
Dive into the Live tab. Explore tank-cams from aquarists around the world. Watch their ecosystems in real time.

beats.onScreen: Profile editing: avatar update and Depth Score meter visible.
beats.narration: Your profile reflects your journey. Update your avatar, track your Depth Score, and connect with mentors or peers.

beats.onScreen: Echo swims by as interface fades out.
beats.narration: The Reef grows with you. Share, connect, and discover — all from the palm of your hand.
